## MapPairs {#sec-mappairs-documentation}

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
{{< skeleton-viz mappairs >}}
:::

### `MapPairs(UF)`
Creates a `MapPairs` instance with the supplied user function. To specify the amount of vertical or horizontal input `Vector`s, you do so as template parameters when creating the `MapPairs` instance, such as `skepu::MapPairs<3, 2>(uf)` which would take 3 vertical and 2 horizontal input `Vector`s.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(int a, int b)
{
    return a + b;
}

int main()
{
    auto cartesian = skepu::MapPairs(sum);
}
```

### `operator()`
Calls the `MapPairs` instance, performing the user function on input `Vector`s, and storing the result in the corresponding location in the output `Matrix`. The vertical input `Vector`s are passed after the output `Matrix`, and the horizontal input `Vector`s are passed after the vertical input `Vector`s.

```{.cpp .run}
#include <skepu>
#include <skepu-lib/io.hpp>

int sum(int v1, int v2, int h)
{
    return v1 + v2 + h;
}

int main()
{
    const int vSize = 3;
    const int hSize = 7;
    skepu::Vector<int> v1(vSize, 1), v2(vSize, 1), h(hSize, 1);
    skepu::Matrix<int> res(vSize, hSize);

    auto cartesian = skepu::MapPairs<2, 1>(sum);

    cartesian(res, v1, v2, h);
    skepu::io::cout << res << "\n";
}
```

```{.text .output}
Matrix[3×7]:
3 3 3 3 3 3 3
3 3 3 3 3 3 3
3 3 3 3 3 3 3
```
